name: Head and neck squamous cancers
theme: the HPV fork · the de-escalation frontier

meta.title: Head and neck squamous cancer in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (oral cavity, oropharynx, larynx, hypopharynx), adult
meta.population: Adults with HNSCC - one spec whose spine is THE HPV FORK: p16-positive oropharyngeal cancer is its own disease (own AJCC 8th staging, own prognosis, own de-escalation frontier - and its own graveyard of failed de-escalations), while HPV-negative disease is the harsher classic biology where a trial now uses HPV-NEGATIVITY ITSELF as the enrollment biomarker. Nasopharyngeal carcinoma reroutes: a distinct EBV-driven entity (EBV-DNA biomarker, induction-gemcitabine paradigm, its own NCCN pathway) whose row may split later - the reroute is honest about pointing at a trainer that does not exist yet.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the disease where de-escalation keeps failing and honesty about it is the curriculum. THE DE-ESCALATION LEDGER is the spine's lesson: three properly-run attempts to give less in HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancer FAILED (RTOG 1016 and De-ESCALaTE both showed cetuximab INFERIOR to cisplatin - non-inferiority not met, survival worse; NRG-HN005's reduced-dose arms halted for futility at interim, presented not published - flagged) while the one surviving frontier is SELECTION-based, not blanket: ctHPV-DNA-clearance-guided adaptation met its phase 2 endpoint…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: AJCC TNM 8th - with HPV-mediated (p16+) oropharyngeal cancer staged SEPARATELY (the ICON-S rebuild); p16 IHC is the tier-1 test for oropharynx primaries and is NOT prognostically validated at non-oropharynx sites (the scope limit said); PD-L1 CPS strata (<1 / 1-19 / >=20) route the R/M first line; NCCN Head and Neck (version secondhand - 403)
meta.response: RECIST 1.1 for R/M disease; post-CRT response assessment routes surveillance; circulating tumor HPV-DNA (ctHPV-DNA) surveillance carried at its honest grade - EMERGING (high negative-predictive-value signals, one met phase 2 endpoint in adaptive de-escalation, not yet guideline-mandated)

Patient.label: Age
Patient.help: The HPV+ disease skews younger; cisplatin candidacy and surgical fitness flex with age and hearing/renal reserve.
Patient.helpPatient: Fitness for strong chemotherapy and big surgery matters more than the birthday - and hearing and kidneys get checked before cisplatin.

Patient.label: Performance status (ECOG)
Patient.help: Nutrition and airway often explain the number here - both actively treated from day one.
Patient.helpPatient: Trouble eating or breathing gets treated as part of the cancer plan, not separately from it.

Disease.helpPatient: Whether a throat cancer is HPV-caused changes its outlook and its playbook - it is effectively a different disease with the same address.

Disease.label: Extent (the three-tine fork)
Disease.help: Resectability here is a multidisciplinary call about function as much as anatomy - a technically removable larynx may still be better served by the organ-preservation road, and RTOG 91-11's verified…
Disease.helpPatient: Three honest situations: operable, treatable-without-surgery (often to save voice or swallowing), and returned-or-spread - each with its own proven playbook.

Newly diagnosed.name: Surgery + risk-adapted adjuvant (chemo)radiation (the resectable backbone)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the resectable backbone (NCCN secondhand); MACH-NC the arithmetic
Newly diagnosed.evidence: guideline-grade composite (flagged headline figure); MACH-NC and JCOG1008 verified beneath
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the operation's functional ledger, then radiation's (mucositis, xerostomia, the swallow at stake)
Newly diagnosed.patient: The operable-disease standard: the operation, then radiation (with chemotherapy when the pathology shows higher risk) - with the dental visit and swallowing exercises built in as parts of the treatment itself.

Newly diagnosed.name: Perioperative pembrolizumab (KEYNOTE-689 - approved ON event-free survival)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: FDA-approved 2025-06 ON EFS, CPS>=1 (secondhand; approval-type conflict noted) - the currency named on the card
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized - EFS decisive (verified paper; headline-number stratum flagged); EFS-labeled: displays, never ranks
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the backbone's ledger plus a year-plus of the immune watch-list
Newly diagnosed.patient: The newest operable-disease option: immunotherapy before and after the operation - approved on proof that it keeps cancer events away longer, with the longer-life question still maturing, and the card says exactly that.

Newly diagnosed.name: Definitive CRT, 70 Gy + q3w cisplatin (HPV+ oropharynx - the arm that killed de-escalation)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the HPV+ LA standard - full dose, full schedule (NRG release + NCCN secondhand): de-escalation lives ONLY in trials
Newly diagnosed.evidence: the standard arm's supremacy shown three times (1016 and De-ESCALaTE verified; HN005 presented-flagged)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: real and front-loaded: mucositis, xerostomia, the swallow at stake - which is exactly why de-escalation keeps being tried, and why it must be earned in trials
Newly diagnosed.patient: For HPV-caused throat cancer treated without surgery: full-dose radiation with strong chemotherapy - the treatment that proved, three separate times, that gentler versions cure fewer people. Wanting gentler is human; earning it happens in trials, and one careful blood-test-guided path is open.

Newly diagnosed.name: Definitive CRT / organ preservation (classic biology - the 91-11 road with its whole ledger)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the unresected classic-biology standard; larynx preservation per 91-11 (NCCN secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized legacy verified (91-11, VA, Bonner, MACH-NC) with flagged percentages; the graveyard named
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: CRT's full ledger - and the 10-year honesty that the concurrent road carries a late non-cancer mortality signal
Newly diagnosed.patient: Treating without surgery - often to keep the voice box: radiation with chemotherapy, the road proven to preserve the larynx in most people, with an honest note that its ten-year follow-up found extra non-cancer deaths that medicine is still explaining.

Newly diagnosed.name: Pembrolizumab alone, 1L R/M (KEYNOTE-048, CPS >= 20)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized (KEYNOTE-048) - OS met; stratum medians flagged, 5-yr tail snippet-verified via the matched update papers
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the immune ledger alone - the gentlest active card on this menu
Newly diagnosed.patient: For returned-or-spread disease with the highest immune-marker score: immunotherapy alone - no chemotherapy - proven to extend life, with one in seven alive at five years versus one in fifteen on the old standard.

Newly diagnosed.name: Pembrolizumab + platinum/5-FU, 1L R/M (KEYNOTE-048 combo, CPS >= 1)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized - OS met with verified 5-yr tail (via matched update papers; primary PMID flagged)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: chemo's ledger plus the immune one - bought against the tail
Newly diagnosed.patient: For returned-or-spread disease with any immune-marker positivity: chemotherapy plus immunotherapy - and at five years, one in six on the combination was alive versus one in nineteen on the old standard.

Newly diagnosed.name: Platinum/5-FU/cetuximab, 1L R/M (EXTREME - the CPS<1 zone)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: chemo's full ledger plus cetuximab's rash-and-magnesium one
Newly diagnosed.patient: When the immune-marker score is truly zero: the proven chemotherapy-plus-antibody combination - the door with an actual receipt for exactly this test result.

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none from therapy; the airway-swallowing-pain craft is the care
Newly diagnosed.patient: Declining treatment is a real choice - with a team whose craft centers on breathing, swallowing, pain, and communication.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Nivolumab 2L platinum-refractory, IO-naive (CheckMate 141)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: phase 3 randomized - OS met (verified; HR flagged)
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: the immune ledger alone - gentler than the chemo it beat
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: After platinum chemotherapy, if immunotherapy hasn't been used yet: immunotherapy alone - it beat chemotherapy on survival and is gentler.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Chemotherapy / cetuximab 2L+ (the measured bar; the doors named)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: randomized control-arm measurement (141's own arm) - the live bar; the gap and its doors named
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: The proven later-line chemotherapy options - and for the newest situation (after immunotherapy has been used), the honest offer is one of two well-designed studies asking exactly that question.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Comfort-focused care
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: Choosing comfort after the proven lines is a real road - and this card carries the field's honest ledger: several hoped-for additions were tested properly and did not work, and the trainer names them.

cisplatin schedule is SETTING-split: weekly OK postoperatively (JCOG1008), 3-weekly for definitive CRT (Noronha long-term)

trials.name: LiGeR-HN1: petosemtamab + pembrolizumab vs pembrolizumab (1L R/M)

Uppaluri et al. KEYNOTE-689: neoadjuvant + adjuvant pembrolizumab, resectable LA-HNSCC - median EFS 51.8 vs 30.4 months (stratum detail of the headline number FLAGGED - secondary source). FDA 2025-06 CPS>=1 (secondhand; approval-TYPE conflicting between sources - re-check label). NEJM 2025 (PMID 40532178, pubmed-url-match) | PMID 40532178 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

KEYNOTE-048 (Burtness): 1L R/M by CPS strata - combo total OS 13.0 vs 10.7 (snippet-verified); mono CPS>=20 14.9 vs 10.7 (medians MEMORY-GRADE FLAGGED); 5-yr tails 16.0% vs 5.2% (combo) / 14.4% vs 6.5% (mono, snippet-verified). CITATION HONESTY: the primary Lancet 2019 PMID resisted matching - the spec anchors on the MATCHED updates: 4-yr (PMID 36219809, JCO 2022), 5-yr (PMID 40262400, 2025), CPS subgroup (PMID 35333599) | PMID 36219809 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: JCO / Lancet (primary PMID flagged; updates matched)

refs.label: RTOG 91-11 (Forastiere): larynx preservation - concurrent CRT preserves the most larynges; 10-YEAR: OS FLAT across arms with EXCESS NON-CANCER LATE DEATHS in the concurrent arm (the late-death signal - direction verified, percentages memory-grade FLAGGED). NEJM 2003 (PMID 14645636, matched) + JCO 2013 long-term (PMID 23182993, matched) | PMID 23182993 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

VA Laryngeal Cancer Study Group (Wolf): induction chemo + RT vs laryngectomy + RT - equal survival, ~2/3 of larynges preserved (exact figures memory-grade FLAGGED) - the organ-preservation founding receipt. NEJM 1991 (PMID 2034244, pubmed-url-match) | PMID 2034244 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

Bonner et al.: cetuximab + RT vs RT alone - median OS 49.0 vs 29.3 months (canonical; verify-on-ingest flag) - the platinum-ineligible lane. NEJM 2006 (PMID 16467544, pubmed-url-match; the 2010 5-yr update's PMID unmatched - FLAG) | PMID 16467544 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

NRG/RTOG 1016: cetuximab-for-cisplatin substitution in HPV+ OPC FAILED non-inferiority - OS HR 1.45 (NI bound 1.94 exceeded); 5-yr PFS 67.3% vs 78.4% (HR 1.72, p=0.0002); 5-yr LRF 17.3% vs 9.9% (verified-snippet). Tombstone #1 on the de-escalation ledger. Lancet 2019 (PMID 30449625, pubmed-url-match - ADJACENT-TRIO NOTE: 30449623 is De-ESCALaTE, 30449624 is the comment) | PMID 30449625 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

De-ESCALaTE HPV (Mehanna): same substitution, low-risk HPV+ OPC - cisplatin DOMINANT (2-yr OS ~97.5% vs ~89.4% - figures memory-grade FLAGGED, direction verified; toxicity NOT reduced by cetuximab). Tombstone #2. Lancet 2019 (PMID 30449623, pubmed-url-match - the comment at 30449624 is NOT the paper) | PMID 30449623 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

NRG-HN005 (NCT03952585): de-intensified 60 Gy arms vs standard 70 Gy + cisplatin in p16+ OPC - reduced-dose arms HALTED FOR FUTILITY at interim; control 2-yr PFS ~98.1% (ASTRO 2024 plenary - PRESENTED, NOT PUBLISHED: FLAGGED, no primary paper). Tombstone #3: de-escalation by clinical factors alone failed again. Predecessor HN002 (Yom, JCO 2021 - PMID unmatched, FLAG) advanced only the cisplatin-containing arm

ECOG-ACRIN E3311 (Ferris): transoral surgery + de-escalated 50 Gy adjuvant RT in intermediate-risk p16+ OPC - ~95% 2-yr PFS; PHASE 2, supportive-not-definitive (the surgical de-escalation lane's honest grade; PATHOS closed 2024-10, results ~2028). JCO 2022 (PMID 34699271, pubmed-url-match); MC1273 (PMID 31163012, matched) the adjuvant-dose hypothesis-generator whose successor (MC1675/DART) reported compromised outcomes in higher-risk subsets (Lancet Oncol 2025, secondhand) | PMID 34699271 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26 | PMID 34699271 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

MACH-NC meta-analysis (Pignon): chemo added to locoregional therapy - HR 0.88, +4.5% absolute 5-yr OS overall; CONCOMITANT: HR 0.81, +6.5%; timing interaction p<0.0001 (concurrent >> induction) - verified-snippet. Radiother Oncol 2009 (PMID 19446902, matched) + 2021 update on 107 trials/19,805 pts (PMID 33515668, matched) | PMID 19446902 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

JCOG1008: weekly cisplatin 40 mg/m2 NONINFERIOR to q3w 100 in POSTOPERATIVE CRT (OS HR 0.69, 99.1% CI upper 1.273; less neutropenia/renal/hearing toxicity - verified-snippet). The setting-scoped shortcut. JCO 2022 (PMID 35230884, pubmed-url-match) | PMID 35230884 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

Noronha et al.: weekly cisplatin 30 mg/m2 INFERIOR to q3w 100 for locoregional control (definitive/adjuvant Indian trial) - long-term update VERIFIED (PMID 39074566, matched); the 2018 primary PMID unmatched (FLAG). The craft lesson: dose AND setting travel together | PMID 39074566 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

EXTREME (Vermorken): platinum/5-FU + cetuximab 1L R/M - OS 10.1 vs 7.4 (verified-snippet; HR ~0.80 memory-grade) - the pre-048 standard, still the CPS<1 zone's receipt. NEJM 2008 (PMID 18784101, pubmed-url-match) | PMID 18784101 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

CheckMate 141 (Ferris): nivolumab 2L platinum-refractory - OS 7.5 vs 5.1 (verified-snippet; HR 0.70 memory-grade FLAG; PFS not improved). The IO-naive receipt; the control arm doubles as the 2L bar. NEJM 2016 (PMID 27718784, pubmed-url-match) | PMID 27718784 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE GRAVEYARD (all secondhand, dated): xevinapant DEAD TWICE - TrilynX stopped at interim futility (2024-06) and X-Ray Vision stopped, asset returned by Merck KGaA (the phase-2-promise-not-confirmed lesson at scale); IO-added-to-definitive-CRT failed THREE times - JAVELIN Head&Neck 100 (avelumab, 2020-21), IMvoke010 (adjuvant atezolizumab - EFS HR 0.94, published JAMA Oncol 2025), KEYNOTE-412 (pembrolizumab+CRT missed). The consolidation slot's re-try (eVOLVE-HNSCC) carries program risk: the same drug's NSCLC trial discontinued 2026. NIVOPOSTOP sits APART on the shelf: POSITIVE adjuvant DFS (ASCO 2025 plenary LBA2, GORTEC - OS immature, not FDA-actionable, KEYNOTE-689 sequencing tension unresolved)

THE SURVIVING FRONTIER (emerging grade, mostly secondhand): ctHPV-DNA surveillance - high-NPV signals (Chera-line work; PMID candidate unmatched, FLAG); ReACT 1.0 (NCT04900623) MET its phase 2 endpoint with clearance-guided de-escalation (2-yr PFS >90% incl. reclassified higher-risk - ASCO 2025 abstr 6009 / Nat Commun 2026, secondhand); ReACT 2.0 (NCT07513324) NOT YET RECRUITING (est. 2026-07). Selection-based de-escalation is the ledger's one live road - guideline-mandated nowhere yet, said in both directions

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

LiGeR-HN1 (NCT06525220): petosemtamab (EGFRxLGR5 bispecific, breakthrough designation) + pembrolizumab vs pembrolizumab, 1L R/M CPS>=1 - dual ORR/OS primaries (UChicago/Stanford/WashU open) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-19, registry re-check due
LiGeR-HN2 (NCT06496178): petosemtamab vs investigator's choice, 2L+ R/M post-PD-1 AND post-platinum - the post-IO gap's phase 3 (ORR/OS primaries) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-19, registry re-check due

FIERCE-HN (NCT06064877): ficlatuzumab (anti-HGF) + cetuximab vs placebo + cetuximab, R/M HNSCC - HPV-NEGATIVE ONLY (the phase 2 signal was HPV-negative-specific: the absence of the virus as the enrollment biomarker), post-anti-PD-(L)1 and post-platinum; OS primary, adaptive (~410-500 pts; Moffitt/Yale/KU open) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-19, registry re-check due

eVOLVE-HNSCC (NCT06129864): volrustomig (PD-1xCTLA-4 bispecific) vs observation after definitive CRT, unresected LA-HNSCC (n~1145; UCSF/Anschutz open) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-19 (AZ page 2026-05-01), re-check due. PROGRAM RISK NAMED: eVOLVE-Lung02 discontinued 2026. Beside it: EA3161 (NCT03811015, maintenance nivo, intermediate-risk HPV+) STATUS CONFLICTED - co-op pages open vs snapshot active-not-recruiting: closed-pending-readout until re-check

OSU ctHPV-DNA-adaptive de-escalation (NCT06323460): mid-treatment ctHPV-DNA clearance gates RT de-intensification in HPV+ OPC - phase 2 pilot, single-site, NOT randomized (honestly graded) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-19 (snippet 2026-03), registry re-check due.
